title: VTG The World of Ginny Vogue Dolls Sweet Rosebud 8" Poseable Vinyl Doll 1984
categoryName: Dolls & Bears:Dolls, Clothing & Accessories:Dolls & Doll Playsets
descriptionText: This vintage Vogue doll from 1984 is part of "The World of Ginny" collection. The 8" poseable vinyl doll named Sweet Rosebud has straight red hair and green eyes. She comes with accessories and original packaging. The doll is Caucasian with a light complexion and is recommended for children ages 3 and up. It is a part of the "Dolls of the World" product line and was manufactured in Hong Kong.
